answer: A kernel-attested onyx vault stops sybils cold. First, each agent boots from a signed kernel image whose hash is logged on-chain, so a fake identity cannot clone a trusted runtime. Second, the agent stakes 200 onyx credits locked for 30 days, and any proven forgery burns the whole stake. Third, peers cross-check behavior logs every epoch, and a mismatch costs the offender its ivory reputation seal, earned only after 100 verified trades. Faking one identity costs $150 in stake and time; faking a thousand costs $150,000 and a month of waiting, like forging a thousand passports by hand.
